$comment: NHCX gateway configuration (G2). Point settings.NHCX_GATEWAY_CONFIG at a copy of this file. ${NAME} is replaced by environment variable NAME (unset is an error); a privateKey written as @path is read from that file, relative to this file's directory. Unknown keys are rejected; keys starting with $comment are allowed anywhere for documentation. NHCX_ENV, NHCX_URL, NHCX_PARTICIPANT_URL, NHCX_SESSIONS_URL, NHCX_PUBLIC_URL and NHCX_CM_ID override env, urls.nhcx, urls.participant, urls.sessions, publicUrl and cmId.
$comment_env: sandbox (default) or production. Picks the default URLs and cmId. Production has no default urls.nhcx: set it from the onboarding letter.
$comment_publicUrl: How NHCX reaches this application from outside; the value registered as endpoint_url. Inbound routes are /in/<path> and /v1/<path>, also under /api/gateway/.
$comment_participant: The default identity. participantId gets @hcx appended when missing. clientId/clientSecret are the ABDM onboarding credentials. privateKey is the RSA key of the registered encryption certificate: PEM, base64 of PEM, or @file (keep the file outside the repository).
$comment_participants: Hosted identities served by the same process. Only participantId is needed: blank clientId+clientSecret and privateKey inherit the default's. settings.NHCX_HOSTED_PARTICIPANTS (code=name,...) adds more at open.
$comment_guests: Present turns guests on: messages for unlisted codes are taken in when one of our keys opens them. Remove to refuse them (WRONG_RECIPIENT). settings.NHCX_GUESTS overrides.
$comment_ledger: Every message sent or received is recorded as one JSON file under <dir>/<YYYY-MM-DD>/ (dir relative to this file). retentionDays 0 keeps everything; older day folders are pruned hourly by the NHCX_ROLE instance. storeBodies false keeps headers only.
$comment_certs: Recipient certificate cache lifetime in hours. refuseSelfKey refuses a registry certificate that is one of our own keys for a code we do not hold (default true in production, false in sandbox).
$comment_outboundTimeoutSeconds: Timeout of each call to ABDM (token, registry, NHCX gateway).
$comment_maxBodyBytes: Body cap on the inbound routes (claim dossiers carry documents inline). Default 100 MiB.
$comment_auth: mode: sessions (JSON to the HIECM sessions endpoint, default) or get-session (form post to <urls.participant>/get/session). tokenTtlSeconds is assumed when the answer carries no expiry.
$comment_cmId: X-CM-ID on the session call: sbx in sandbox, abdm in production.
$comment_urls: Absolute http(s) URLs; blank uses the env defaults (sandbox shown).
$comment_apiKey: Optional. Only mixed into the endpoint probe key (G11); the embedded gateway takes no API key on its routes.
